title: Backblaze B2 Uploads
subtitle: Store forum uploads in Backblaze B2 (S3-compatible)
field.endpoint.help: From your B2 bucket details ("S3 API")
field.region.help: The bit between s3. and .backblazeb2.com in the endpoint
field.appKey.help: Stored in NodeBB settings DB. Use a key restricted to this single bucket.
field.presignTtl.help: How long redirected presigned URLs stay valid. Browser caches the redirect for TTL minus 60s.
limits.notice: Heads up: NodeBB has its own global upload size limit in Settings → Uploads. Whichever is lower wins.
saved.title: Saved
saved.message: B2 settings saved. Connection has been re-initialised.
status.label: Status
bunny.notice: When enabled, the proxy will redirect to a Bunny CDN URL with a token instead of a direct B2 presigned URL. Bunny pulls from B2 once and caches at the edge — much faster delivery and free B2→Bunny transfer (Bandwidth Alliance). Permission checks still happen on every request.
field.bunnyTokenKey.help: From Bunny dashboard: Pull Zone → Security → Token Authentication Key. Token Authentication must be enabled on the zone.
field.bunnyTokenTtl.help: Leave 0 to use the same TTL as B2 presigned URLs. Max 604800 (7 days).
maintenance.notice: Files uploaded but never used in a saved post become orphans. Periodically the plugin scans for orphans older than the threshold and removes them from B2 plus their metadata from the database.
field.cleanupAgeHours.help: Default 24. Anything below 1 is clamped to 1.
field.cleanupIntervalHours.help: How often the background sweep runs. Default 6.
